## Should flag

Our company values excellence, collaboration, and innovation in everything we do. *(business-memo)*

The study examined reliability, validity, and generalization across multiple experimental conditions. *(academic)*

The activist demonstrated clarity, determination, and compassion in her work as a social leader. *(journalism)*

The policy emphasized excellence, accountability, and realism in setting organizational goals. *(legal-policy)*

## Should not flag

The presentation covered three topics: authentication, authorization, and accounting systems. *(technical-reference)*

She appreciated his thoughtfulness and his genuine concern for her wellbeing. *(fiction)*
